neighbours.label: A participle (directed, leveled, turned) that is followed by the target of hostile action: 'directed against', 'leveled at'
fire: The protests were directed against the new tax on fuel.
Harsh criticism was leveled at the referee after the match.
Her anger was directed against the men who ran the mill.
The same charges could be leveled at almost any large bank.
Attacks directed against nurses rose sharply last year.
Sanctions turned against the regime within a year.
Violence directed against minorities drew a response from the court.
The accusations leveled at the senator were quickly denied.
quiet: The protests were organized for the new tax on fuel.
Harsh weather was reported near the stadium after the match.
Her time was spent with the women who ran the mill.
The same charts could be shown for almost any large bank.
Training offered to nurses rose sharply last year.
Sanctions eased in the region within a year.
Help directed to minorities drew a response from the court.
The accusations about the senator were quickly denied.
